units.source_text: 植村掌柜慌忙走出账房，一本正经地酬酢了一番。

en.t: Shopkeeper Uemura hurried out of the accounting room and exchanged formal courtesies with complete seriousness.

units.source_text: 他讲了很长时间，龙助也应答了，却一直板着面孔。

en.t: He talked for a long time, and Ryusuke answered him, but his face remained stiff and expressionless throughout.

units.source_text: 这种冷漠劲，植村当然看在眼里。

en.t: Uemura, of course, noticed this coldness.
